latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — free AI-driven image-to-video skill.

- Instantly converts single images into 1080p MP4 video clips via plain instructions; no manual video editing required.
- Seamless workflow: upload image(s), describe the result, and receive downloadable videos in ~30–60 seconds.
- Full support for video, audio, and text overlay tracks with quick cloud GPU rendering.
- Requires no account—auto-generates a free API token if needed.
- Built-in credit tracking, error handling, and support for multiple file formats (mp4, mov, avi, webm, etc).
- Clear, step-by-step feedback throughout upload, editing, and export.
